title: CLI run pipeline + JSON report (secret redaction enforced)
acceptance_criteria: CLI: python -m authagent run --url http://localhost:8889 runs allowlist-check -> discovery -> signup -> login -> success -> logout -> re-login (and email step when present)
Per-run JSON report written to a run dir: step timeline with timestamps, discovered routes, screenshots paths, pass/fail per step, clear failure reasons
Secrets (generated creds, cookies) NEVER appear in the JSON report or stdout; redaction unit-tested against the real report object
Exit code nonzero on failure/refusal; allowlist refusal surfaces as a clear message and nonzero exit
CLI contract MUST remain exactly: python -m authagent run --url <site> (a coordinator skill /helpmewallet depends on it). Do not rename or restructure this subcommand/flag.

Fix the invalid-JSON report bug: runs/e2e-localhost_8889.json is invalid because the fresh_session key is masked to [REDACTED] by redact() (keys containing session/cookie/secret get masked). Rename that key (as done for the signal key in commit 099480d) so the emitted JSON is VALID and parseable. Add a test asserting the written report parses with json.load.

Deliver the EXACT CLI contract `python -m authagent run --url <site>` (a `run` subcommand) because the installed /helpmewallet skill invokes exactly that; keep the existing --e2e/--crawl/--signup flags working too.
